newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia's Colly Farms prospectus lodged.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia's Colly Farms prospectus lodged.

text.p: The prospectus for the upcoming listing of Colly Farms Cotton Group Ltd has been lodged with the Australian Securities Commission, a market source told Reuters on Monday.

The listing of Australia's largest cotton producer is expected to raise about A$100 million for its owner, the Federal government's Commonwealth Funds Management, and will be underpinned by an agreement struck with Argentine-based investor John Kahlbetzer to take a 25 percent stake, the source said.
County Natwest had agreed to underwrite the placement of the remaing stock, the source said.
Local, U.K. and European institutions are expected to hold about 50 percent of Colly's issued capital, with a listing expected towards the end of the year.
Colly Farms, which has cotton growing and ginning operations in the north-west of New South Wales, had a drought-affected calendar 1995 net profit of A$830,000 on sales of A$293 million.
It plans to switch to a July/June year when it is listed and has predicted a much-improved 1996 result.
Colly Farms was due to be floated in August but fluctuating share and commodity markets encouraged its brokers to seek a "cornerstone" investor whose presence would attract others.
